mcqs.question: Under the India–Canada trade discussions in May 2026, what bilateral trade target was set for 2030, alongside the aim of concluding the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) by the end of 2026?
mcqs.explanation: India and Canada set a target of US$50 billion in bilateral trade by 2030 and aimed to conclude the CEPA by the end of 2026. US$17 billion and approximately C$32 billion refer to the current trade level, while US$100 billion refers to Canadian pension-fund investment in India.
